title: Restriction to constructible module sheaves
statement: For a qcqs scheme and independently sized Noetherian coefficients, canonical inverse image of [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-data] induces an equivalence from the intrinsic constructible etale module category of [def-pe-etale-constructible-module] to the full affine-locally constructible pro-etale module category of [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. The forward functor is identified with that actual inverse image.

source.place: part (1); local/classical detail for the finite stratification arguments

proof.text:
the constructibility test lifts the canonical inverse image to the two full
subcategories. Ambient full faithfulness gives fullness and faithfulness there.
A constructible target is continuous by the finite-cover classicality argument;
classical descent supplies an etale antecedent and an isomorphism of its image
with the target. Constructibility is invariant under that isomorphism and reflected
by inverse image, so this antecedent belongs to the source full subcategory.
This proves essential surjectivity. The resulting equivalence uses this lifted
functor itself, so its forward-functor identification is reflexive.

proof_origin.place: part (1); local/classical detail for the finite stratification arguments
